annotations.title: Pause, resume or change the target of a price watch

description: Changes one of the signed-in person's watches: `paused: true` stops the mails until `paused: false`; `target_total` sets a new limit (null = any real drop under the saved total). Only the token's own watches; another id answers not_found.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.
